source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 6.10, printed pages 134-135, with Sample problem 6.9 and Quick Check 6.7 as self-checks.

blocks.text: Kisi compound ki lattice energy ek single direct experiment (seedhe tajurbe) se maloom karna impossible (na-mumkin) hai. Lekin kai experimental values aur ek energy cycle, jise Born–Haber cycle kehte hain, se ΔH°latt nikal sakte hain. Born-Haber cycle Hess’ law ka hi ek istemal hai. Aayiye Hess’ law aur Born-Haber cycle se sodium chloride ki lattice energy nikalte hain.

blocks.alt: Teen light blue boxes ka triangle: Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g) (oopar baen), Na+Cl-(s) (oopar daen) aur Na+(g) + Cl-(g) (neeche). Oopar baen se oopar daen arrow: delta H(o)f. Elements se neeche gaseous ions tak arrow: delta Hx. Gaseous ions se oopar Na+Cl-(s) tak arrow: delta H(o)latt.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.8: Sodium chloride ka enthalpy cycle (kitab ki Figure 6.8 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Elements Na(s) + ½Cl₂(g) se NaCl(s) tak do raste hain: seedha (ΔH°f), ya pehle gaseous ions Na⁺(g) + Cl⁻(g) banana (ΔHx) aur phir ions se solid banana (ΔH°latt). Is liye ΔHx + ΔH°latt = ΔH°f.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.8 mein oopar daen box 'Na⁺Cl⁻(g)' chhapa hai aur ΔH°latt ka arrow solid se gaseous ions ki taraf hai. Lattice energy gaseous ions se solid banne ki change hai, is liye sahi box Na⁺Cl⁻(s) aur arrow ions se solid ki taraf hai, jaisa oopar diagram mein hai.

items: ΔH°f: NaCl ki standard enthalpy of formation, jo calorimeter mein aasani se napi ja sakti hai.
ΔHx: sodium aur chlorine ko un ki standard physical states se gaseous ions banane mein lagne wali total energy. Is cycle par Hess’ law lagayen to:

blocks.text: Is energy triangle ko phaila kar ΔHx ke saare steps dikhaye gaye hain. Yeh complete energy cycle Born-Haber cycle kehlata hai (Figure 6.9).

blocks.alt: Born-Haber energy staircase (scale par nahi). Mota reactants level Na(s) + 1/2 Cl2(g) se: delta Hat of Na = +108 kJ mol-1 oopar Na(g) + 1/2 Cl2(g) tak; delta Hi of Na = +496 oopar Na+(g) + e- + 1/2 Cl2(g) tak; delta Hat of Cl2 = +121 oopar Na+(g) + e- + Cl(g) tak; delta Hea of Cl = -349 neeche Na+(g) + Cl-(g) tak; phir mota arrow neeche, delta Hlatt of Na+Cl-(s) = ?, aakhri product Na+Cl-(s) tak. Reactants se seedha arrow neeche Na+Cl-(s) tak: delta Hf = -411 kJ mol-1.
blocks.caption: Figure 6.9: Sodium chloride ka Born-Haber cycle (scale ke mutabiq nahi) (kitab ki Figure 6.9 ke mutabiq hamari apni drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Seerhi (stairs) ka har step ek change hai: sodium ka atom banna (+108), us ka ion banna (+496), chlorine ka atom banna (+121) aur chlorine ka electron lena (–349). Oopar jayen to energy absorb, neeche aayen to release. Dono raste barabar hain, is liye lattice energy = –411 – 376 = –787 kJ mol⁻¹.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 6.9 mein pehle step ke baad 'Na⁺(g) + ½Cl₂' chhapa hai (sahi: Na(g) + ½Cl₂(g)) aur sab se oopar 'Cl₂(g)' (sahi: Cl(g)). Oopar diagram mein dono sahi hain.
